title: Bodhanā
text: 2. Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā ekām antaṃ nisīdi || || 3. Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Bojjhaṅgā bojjhaṅgāti bhante vuccanti || || Kittāvatā nu kho bhante Bhojjhaṅgā ti vuccantī ti || || Bodhāya saṃvattantīti kho bhikkhu || tasmā Bhojjhaṅgāti vuccanti || || 3. Idha bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti || pe-la || {Upekhāsambojjhaṅgam} bhāveti vivekanissitam virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇamiṃ || || 4. Bodhāya saṃvattantī ti kho bhikkhu tasmā Bojjhaṅgā ti vuccantī ti || ||
